references.context: Commutative algebra: quotient κ=R/m by the maximal ideal of a local ring
Field theory: field with no nontrivial separable algebraic extensions, distinct from algebraically closed in positive characteristic

references.disposition: This does not require absence of nontrivial purely inseparable algebraic extensions.

review_rationale: Read the strict Henselian criterion as Henselianity plus a separably closed residue field, not an algebraically closed residue field: purely inseparable extensions may remain.
